UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public learner profile with learning statistics, current target language and levels.

currentLanguage.description: L2 Language target, e.g. English, French, Spanish, German

lastActiveDate.description: ISO date string of last activity

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated collection containing sensitive user PII.

LearnedWord.title: LearnedWord
LearnedWord.description: Vocabulary items saved, practicing or mastered by the learner.

masteryLevel.description: 0 for new, 1 for active, 2 for mastered

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp for spaced repetition timing

ConversationScenario.title: ConversationScenario
ConversationScenario.description: Scenario session of chat practice with the Gemini bot.

scenarioId.description: Identifier of Preset Scenario (e.g. airport_checkin, order_coffee)

evaluationFeedback.description: Evaluative feedback comments generated of the chat

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A single text message exchanged during an AI-powered dialog session.

feedback.description: Grammar and phrasing correction comments, if any

/users/{userId}.description: Retrieves public profile information of learners.

/users/{userId}/private/info.description: Isolated partition containing highly protected PII information.

/users/{userId}/words/{wordId}.description: Accesses or archives vocabulary items mastered.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Preset dialogues practice workspace sessions with foreign native bots.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}/messages/.description: Chronological speech elements containing interactive lines of dialog.
